QuestInfo.name: Receiving Power B. Fore's Certificate of Training Again
QuestInfo.0: You lost the Certificate of Training that #p1012118# gave you. Without it, you won't be able to enter the Training Center. Go see #b#p1012118##k again.
QuestInfo.1: You'll be able to receive the Certificate of Training from #p1012118# again by training some more. Hunt 50 #o1210101#s.\n\n#o1210101##r #a225201##k
QuestInfo.2: You hunted the #o1210101#s. Hmm... You're not sure how much longer you'll be able to train here.

yes.0: As a part of your training, hunt #r50 #o1210101#s#k. Only difficult training like that will make you a master!

no.0: You refuse? revolting already? Now, now... You're not nearly strong enough to fight me. Hehe, why don't you cool your head and then come back.

1.0: Ah, you defeated 50 #o1210101#s? Faster than I thought. Of course, it's all a result of my training. Here, take this.

yes.0: You must be very happy to receive the Certificate you so desired. Puhaha.

mob.0: Haven't you defeated #r50 #o1210101#s#k yet? What's with all the trainees unable to keep up with the intensity of my training?
